blocks.heading_context: ## The Big Picture: Levels of Organization
blocks.text:
ORGANISM
  ~37 trillion cells, ~206 bones, ~600 muscles
  -> ORGAN SYSTEMS (11)
     cardiovascular, respiratory, nervous, endocrine, immune
     digestive, renal, reproductive, musculoskeletal
     integumentary, lymphatic
     -> ORGANS
        heart, lungs, liver, kidneys, brain, skin...
        -> TISSUES (4 primary types)
           epithelial, connective, muscle, nervous
           -> CELLS (~200 types)
              cardiomyocytes, neurons, hepatocytes, chondrocytes
              -> MOLECULES
                 proteins, lipids, nucleic acids, carbohydrates

+--------------------+  +--------------------+  +--------------------+
|  MUSCULOSKELETAL   |  |  CARDIOVASCULAR    |  |  RESPIRATORY       |
|  Frame + motion    |  |  Pump + pipes      |  |  Gas exchange      |
|  bones/cartilage   |  |  heart + vessels   |  |  lungs + airways   |
|  joints/tendons    |  |  O₂ + nutrient     |  |  O₂/CO₂ swap       |
|  skeletal muscle   |  |  delivery          |  |  pH buffer         |
+--------------------+  +--------------------+  +--------------------+

+--------------------+  +--------------------+  +--------------------+
|  NERVOUS           |  |  ENDOCRINE         |  |  IMMUNE            |
|  Fast signaling    |  |  Slow signaling    |  |  Defense           |
|  CNS + PNS + ANS   |  |  hormones via      |  |  innate + adaptive |
|  millisecond scale |  |  bloodstream       |  |  memory + self-    |
|                    |  |  minutes-hours     |  |  tolerance         |
+--------------------+  +--------------------+  +--------------------+

+--------------------+  +--------------------+  +--------------------+
|  DIGESTIVE         |  |  RENAL/URINARY     |  |  REPRODUCTIVE      |
|  Nutrient intake   |  |  Filtration +      |  |  Gametogenesis     |
|  GI tract + liver  |  |  homeostasis       |  |  fertilization     |
|  + pancreas        |  |  nephron-based     |  |  development       |
|  absorption        |  |  acid-base ctrl    |  |                    |
+--------------------+  +--------------------+  +--------------------+

          +--------------------+  +--------------------+
          |  INTEGUMENTARY     |  |  LYMPHATIC         |
          |  Barrier + thermo  |  |  Fluid return      |
          |  skin + hair +     |  |  immune transit    |
          |  nails + glands    |  |  fat absorption    |
          +--------------------+  +--------------------+

SET POINT (reference)
  -> ERROR DETECTOR
     compares sensed value with set point
  -> EFFECTOR
     actuator: muscle, gland, or organ
  -> CONTROLLED VARIABLE
     body state being regulated
  -> SENSOR (afferent)
     reports current value back to the detector

+-------------------+--------------------------------------------------+
| EPITHELIAL        | Linings, barriers, secretory surfaces            |
|                   | Skin surface, GI lining, kidney tubules, alveoli |
|                   | Avascular — no direct blood supply               |
|                   | Polarity: apical face ≠ basolateral face         |
|                   | Subtypes: simple/stratified × squamous/cuboidal/ |
|                   |           columnar                               |
+-------------------+--------------------------------------------------+
| CONNECTIVE        | Structure, support, transport, storage           |
|                   | Bone, cartilage, tendons, adipose, blood, fascia |
|                   | Defined by extracellular matrix (ECM):           |
|                   | collagen, elastin, proteoglycans, hydroxyapatite |
|                   | in bone                                          |
+-------------------+--------------------------------------------------+
| MUSCLE            | Contractile force generation                     |
|                   | Skeletal — voluntary, striated, multinucleated   |
|                   | Cardiac — involuntary, striated, intercalated    |
|                   |           discs, one or two nuclei               |
|                   | Smooth — involuntary, non-striated, single       |
|                   |          nucleus, organs and vessels             |
+-------------------+--------------------------------------------------+
| NERVOUS           | Electrical + chemical signaling                  |
|                   | Neurons (signal) + glia (support, insulate,      |
|                   | maintain: astrocytes, oligodendrocytes,          |
|                   | Schwann cells, microglia)                        |
|                   | Axon = wire; myelin = insulation; synapse = gap  |
+-------------------+--------------------------------------------------+

TOTAL BODY WATER ~42 L
  INTRACELLULAR FLUID (ICF) ~28 L (67%)
    Dominant ions: K+, Mg2+, HPO4(2-), proteins
    Low: Na+, Cl-, Ca2+

  EXTRACELLULAR FLUID (ECF) ~14 L (33%)
    Dominant ions: Na+, Cl-, HCO3-
    Low: K+, proteins

    Interstitial: ~11 L (78%), bathes cells
    Plasma:       ~3 L (22%), plus RBCs = ~5 L blood

ANS
           ┌──────────┴──────────┐
      SYMPATHETIC            PARASYMPATHETIC
  "fight or flight"          "rest and digest"
  NE / epinephrine           ACh transmitter
  ↑ HR, ↑ BP                 ↓ HR, ↓ BP
  bronchodilate              bronchoconstrict
  inhibit digestion          stimulate digestion
  gluconeogenesis            glycogen synthesis
  dilate pupil               constrict pupil

Low BP / low Na⁺ / low renal perfusion
  ↓
Juxtaglomerular cells → Renin
  ↓
Angiotensinogen (liver) → Angiotensin I
  ↓ (ACE — in lung capillaries)
Angiotensin II
  ├── Vasoconstriction (↑ BP directly)
  └── Adrenal cortex → Aldosterone
        ↓
        Kidney: Na⁺ + H₂O retention → ↑ blood volume → ↑ BP

GLUCOSE (6C)
  ↓ Glycolysis (cytoplasm)          → 2 ATP net, 2 pyruvate, 2 NADH
  ↓ Pyruvate dehydrogenase          → 2 Acetyl-CoA, 2 CO₂, 2 NADH
  ↓ TCA / Krebs cycle (mitoch.)     → 2 ATP, 6 NADH, 2 FADH₂, 4 CO₂
  ↓ Oxidative phosphorylation (ETC) → ~32 ATP (gradient-driven)

TOTAL: ~36–38 ATP per glucose

FATTY ACIDS: β-oxidation
  Palmitate (C16) → ~129 ATP
  Fat is ~2.3× more energy-dense than carbs per gram

ANAEROBIC (no O₂):
  Glycolysis only → 2 ATP + lactate
  pH drops, fatigue sets in
